A Must-Try Local Experience in Nha Trang – Bun Quay A Ken!
Oct 2024 • Friends
As a tourist, I was eager to try some authentic local food in Nha Trang, and Bun Quay A Ken delivered an excellent experience. Their Bun Quay vermicelli is something special, with fresh vermicelli and seafood cooked to perfection. The squid and prawn patty stood out with their great flavor, and the homemade condiments added an extra layer of taste.

The restaurant has a cozy, simple atmosphere, and the staff were welcoming and helpful, guiding me through the menu. I recommend trying their sugarcane juice or kumquat tea—both were refreshing, especially on a hot day.

If you’re in Nha Trang and want to experience local flavors, Bun Quay A Ken is definitely a place you should visit. It’s all about great food and friendly service here—well worth a try!

Bun Quay A Ken – Simplicity Done Right!
Sep 2024 • Couples
If you’re looking for flashy flavors or a super-rich broth, Bun Quay A Ken might surprise you – but in the best way possible! The broth here is not the kind that punches you in the face. Instead, it’s a clear, light soup that lets the seafood do all the talking. You can literally taste the freshness of the squid and seafood with every bite. It’s the kind of dish that doesn’t try too hard but leaves a lasting impression.

The star of my bowl was the squid. It was unbelievably fresh, cooked just right so that it was tender but still had that satisfying bite. The fish and prawn patties were equally delicious, with a bouncy texture that told me they were made from fresh, quality ingredients. And here’s a fun part: you get to mix your own dipping sauce! You can make it as spicy or tangy as you want, which adds a personal touch to every meal.

The restaurant itself is cozy and has a laid-back vibe. It wasn’t fancy, but the staff made me feel right at home. Even though it got busy, the service was still quick and efficient. I also loved that the focus is on keeping things simple – no unnecessary extras, just fresh seafood in a clear broth that highlights the natural flavors.

It’s an honest, straightforward dish that’s perfect when you want something refreshing but satisfying. And with prices that range from just 45K to 65K, it’s an absolute steal. Don’t skip this spot if you’re in Nha Trang and want to taste something truly local and fresh!

First Time trying Bun Quay A Ken in Nha Trang and We loved it!!!
Sep 2024 • Friends
It was our 3rd trip to Vietnam and 1st time in Nha Trang, we wanted something hot and soupy due to the constant rain and found this gem. The welcoming staff guided us through the ordering process. Despite the rain, the place was packed, but service was fast. I tried the owner’s secret sauce at the condiments counter, which was delicious. The lime tea or they call it kuamquat was refreshing, unlike anything I've had in the Philippines. The broth was clear, and the squid tasted really fresh. The vermicelli was sweet, and the prawn cake became my favorite. 1 thing I dont really like is the air-conditioned + fan, the weather is cold enough and they still turn on the fan making me chill, but its fine after I start eating. Overall, very satisfied!
